comments.body: Should this be marked as a fix for 4.8.0, instead of 4.7.1?

If I have read the tea leaves correctly, there will be a RC-2 for 4.7.1, and presumably this would be part of it. Bethany Seeger can confirm that. In that case, we will cherry-pick this commit into the 4.7.1-RC branch.

Unknown, ben_cail - I think there will be another RC soon. We'd like for some more testing to be done to the RC-1 before we cut the 2nd one, to tease out any more issues, if there are any. This fix could probably be part of the 2nd RC, depending on what Andrew Woods (and others) think.
+1 to adding this PR to the 4.7.1 RC branch.

Backported this fix to the 4.7.1-RC branch
